description: MainActivity.kt is an Android activity written in Kotlin that handles permission checks, user interface interactions, and performs SSH test connections using either a real or fake SSH client, as well as managing notification listener permissions and UI updates.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: An Android activity responsible for managing notification permissions, displaying status, and testing SSH connections.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets content view, binds UI handlers, and starts UI binding process.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Refreshes permission UI when activity resumes.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Cancels coroutines scope when activity is destroyed.

methods.name: bindUi
methods.description: Sets up coroutine flows to bind data (last result, last status, SSH config) to UI elements.

methods.name: refreshPermissionUi
methods.description: Updates UI elements based on notification listener and notification permission status.

methods.name: isNotificationListenerEnabled
methods.description: Checks if the notification listener service is enabled.

methods.name: needsPostNotificationsPermission
methods.description: Determines if POST_NOTIFICATIONS permission is needed.

methods.name: openNotificationAccessSettings
methods.description: Opens notification listener settings page, with fallback to app details.

methods.name: onRequestPermissionsResult
methods.description: Handles result of permission request to update UI accordingly.

methods.name: openSettingsActivity
methods.description: Navigates to SettingsActivity or app details on failure.

methods.name: openAppSelectionActivity
methods.description: Navigates to AppSelectionActivity or app details on failure.

methods.name: launchTestSsh
methods.description: Performs an SSH test using configured credentials and updates UI with results.
